template.api.heading: Use this workflow from code
template.api.body: Every Comfy workflow is a JSON graph. The payload below is this workflow, exactly as ComfyUI runs it — fetch it from the URL, keep it in version control, or load it in ComfyUI and run it node by node.
template.api.error: Could not load the workflow JSON. Fetch it from the URL above instead.
template.api.sdkIntro: Run it from TypeScript or Python with the Comfy SDK. The same code targets Comfy Cloud or a ComfyUI you host yourself — only the base URL changes.
template.api.sdkNote: The SDK takes a workflow in API format: open this workflow in ComfyUI and use File → Export Workflow (API).
template.api.apiKeyNotice: API access requires a Comfy Cloud plan with an API key.
